about.title: About LibraMail
about.disclaimer: LibraMail is a local and independent email client. Accounts, messages and settings stay in the local application folder. Version checking only queries public GitHub releases to report that an update exists, without blocking use.
update.checkingDetail: LibraMail is quietly checking whether a newer version has been published.

update.currentDetail: Version {version} is the latest known release.
